The '''Spiral Double Cup''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] tournament held aboard a [[Unidentified leisure satellite|leisure satellite]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
